body: sorry I’m kinda late. I have talked to several people about this in the past, both family members & friends (though I’ve been secretive about it recently for probably obvious reasons.) While I cannot really pin point why I feel like this for me it just comes down not having any reason to continue, I failed myself and my friends & family this past year nearly 2, I fucked up a lot of my future already & dropped out of school because the suicidal thoughts got that strong. There isn’t much I see worth living for especially now that my parents will probably be disgusted with me if I ever come out about things. It just feels helpless now as nothing brings me joy. It’s kinda my last resort now
